neighbours.label: the word that links a comparison to its standard in equative and similarity comparisons ('as many … as', 'in the same way that', 'as was the case', 'just as it does', 'more quickly than'); the same words outside a comparison stay quiet
fire: The new bridge carries twice as much traffic as the old one did.
A heat pump moves warmth in much the same way that a fridge does.
As was the case last winter, the roads were closed for a week.
The new phone charges just as fast as the old model did.
Bats find insects in a similar way dolphins find fish.
Prices rose more sharply this year than economists had predicted.
The river flooded the town, as it had done in 1953.
The tablet works much like a laptop does, only smaller.
quiet: The new bridge carries heavy traffic across the river every day.
A heat pump moves warmth from the garden into the house.
As the winter went on, the roads were closed for a week.
The new phone charges overnight on the kitchen table.
Bats find insects in the dark using sound.
Prices rose this year in most of the shops in town.
The river flooded the town on a cold night in 1953.
The tablet works on the train and in the car.
